channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Tattersall Distilling Introduces Hemp THC Beverages
item.description: The Tattersall functional beverage lineup includes two mood-based options: Uplift and Unwind.

item.title: Like Air, Copper Cow Launch Coffee Puffcorn
item.description: Like Air has teamed up with Copper Cow Coffee to introduce a Vietnamese coffee–flavored puffcorn as a limited-edition online-exclusive. The collaboration highlights how co-branded flavor innovation and social commerce are shaping faster, consumer-led product development.

item.title: Bel Names Peter McGuinness CEO, North America
item.description: Bel Group has appointed Peter McGuinness as CEO of Bel North America, bringing seasoned leadership in scaling purpose-driven food brands. The move signals Bel’s focus on accelerating innovation, manufacturing capacity and sustainable growth across the US and Canada.

item.title: Conagra Adds Protein-Packed Breakfast Bowls
item.description: Conagra Brands is expanding its Banquet portfolio with MEGA Breakfast Bowls designed to meet rising demand for high-protein morning meals. Featuring tray-in-tray steaming technology, the bowls combine convenience, value and texture-forward performance in four varieties.

item.title: Ancient + Brave Rethinks Gut Health Formulation
item.description: Ancient + Brave has launched True Biome, a gut health supplement built around prebiotic, postbiotic and amino acid ingredients rather than live cultures. The formulation reflects growing interest in gut barrier support, immune signaling and digestive tolerance, signaling new directions for digestive health innovation.

item.title: Banagua Emerges as Banana Water Contender
item.description: Banagua is gaining attention as a fast-rising player in the better-for-you beverage space with a single-ingredient banana water. The brand’s minimalist formulation and proprietary extraction process highlight growing interest in simple, naturally functional hydration alternatives.

item.title: Omeat Rebrands as Evergreen Select
item.description: Formerly known as Omeat, Evergreen Select is repositioning cultivated beef as a B2B infrastructure solution designed to stabilize the traditional meat supply. The rebrand and $6 million funding round highlight growing interest in practical, scalable approaches to integrating cultivated meat into existing systems.

item.title: Wonder Juice Expands Wonder Green Line
item.description: Wonder Juice is growing its Wonder Green lineup with two new cold-pressed blends designed to support daily wellness and functional performance. Clean Green and Veg8 & Cayenne highlight how brands are pairing approachable flavors with nutrient-dense ingredients to meet evolving consumer expectations.

item.title: Culture Pop, Noah Kahan Launch Limited Soda
item.description: Culture Pop has teamed with artist Noah Kahan to release a limited-edition Sparkling Black Cherry soda supporting The Busyhead Project. The collaboration blends clean-label, functional soda with cause-driven branding, highlighting how partnerships can connect product launches with purpose.

item.title: Kraft Heinz Plans $600M Push Into R&D, Brand Support
item.description: Amid continued volume declines in center-store categories, Kraft Heinz is redirecting capital toward R&D, marketing and product superiority initiatives — signaling renewed emphasis on formulation upgrades and brand reinvestment heading into 2026.
